segments.name: Payment processing
segments.description: Payment processing services enabling merchants to receive and facilitate payments in emerging markets.
segments.evidence: The Group operates as a single operating segment, "payment processing".

revenueModel.text: International merchants pay for payment processing services to receive payments and facilitate payments in emerging markets.
revenueModel.evidence: The Group derives its revenues from delivering services to international merchants (mainly in the United States, Europe, and China), enabling them to receive payments and facilitate payments in emerging markets.
